components.name: Storybook Page
components.description: The canonical twilight-cover and parchment-folio shell for one-purpose flows.
components.html:
HEARTH

A home for the moments words don’t fit.

One calm story, one clear next action.
components.css: .ds-cover { width: 320px; height: 560px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #2D2436; border-radius: 36px; } .ds-story-page { position: relative; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(126,68,51,.34); border-radius: 30px; background: #FFF8EE; color: #4B2E24; box-shadow: 0 12px 22px rgba(32,22,41,.24); } .ds-binding { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: space-evenly; background: #F0787F; } .ds-binding i { width: 6px; height: 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: #FCEBDD; opacity: .82; } .ds-wordmark { position: absolute; top: 16px; width: 100%; text-align: center; font: 800 13px/18px HearthNunito-ExtraBold, Nunito, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 5px; } .ds-story-content { padding: 84px 28px 24px 42px; } .ds-story-content h2 { max-width: 250px; margin: 0 0 12px; font: 600 34px/39px HearthFredoka, Fredoka, sans-serif; } .ds-story-content p { max-width: 250px; margin: 0; color: #77594B; font: 400 16px/23px HearthNunito, Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-story-page:hover { border-color: rgba(126,68,51,.42); } .ds-story-page:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #875E99; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Hearth should feel like opening a private story that belongs to two people. A deep twilight cover protects a warm parchment folio; coral binding stitches, friendly type, and a tiny code-built voxel hearth make the interface feel held, handmade, and recognizably connected to the shared home. The reviewed visual direction originates in the shared-house field-guide concept, seed `45488e1d`.

This is a calm operating interface, not decorative nostalgia. Each surface leads with one plain promise or task, keeps supporting copy brief, and makes the next action obvious without urgency, blame, scoring, or surveillance cues. `HearthTheme` is the normative semantic source and the reusable storybook primitives in `HearthPrimitives.tsx` are its canonical expression. The exported `ui`, `editorial`, and `hearthUi` objects are compatibility-only surfaces for older screens: migrate them toward `HearthTheme`; never treat them as parallel themes or source new work from them. Voxel-scene palettes and avatar presets remain separate art domains.
keyCharacteristics: Protective twilight outer cover with one warm parchment working surface.
Coral binding and code-built pixel details that connect UI to the voxel home.
Fredoka-led promises with Nunito-led explanation, controls, and status.
Clay for the one primary action; sage for supportive or parallel actions.
Left-led reading order, generous quiet space, and a thumb-reachable action foot.
Calm, relationship-safe state copy with visible recovery and no raw infrastructure detail.

rules.name: Cover-and-Folio
rules.body: Twilight belongs outside the working page; parchment owns the content field. Preserve that nesting whenever a flow needs the storybook shell.

rules.name: One-Clay-Action
rules.body: Give clay to the single forward action. Use sage for a meaningful alternative and quiet clay text for retreat or reset.

rules.name: Compatibility-Is-Not-A-Theme
rules.body: New UI consumes `HearthTheme`; `ui`, `editorial`, and `hearthUi` exist only to keep older surfaces stable while they migrate.

rules.name: Promise-and-Prose
rules.body: Fredoka says what the moment means; Nunito explains what happens next. Do not use generic serif, system display, or unrelated novelty faces as substitutes.

rules.name: Sentence-Case
rules.body: Controls and guidance read like calm speech. Reserve spaced uppercase for the small `HEARTH` wordmark and intentionally letterspaced private codes.

rules.name: One-Story-Column
rules.body: Preserve a single obvious reading path and a single major task per surface; the folio is not a dashboard grid.

rules.name: Reachable-Ending
rules.body: The primary action closes the visual sentence at the page foot, but scrolling and keyboard avoidance always outrank a fixed bottom position.

rules.name: Folio-Casts-the-Room
rules.body: Ambient elevation belongs to the main folio; nested content is usually tonal and bordered, not independently floating.

rules.name: Tactile-Only
rules.body: Add a control shadow only when it helps the primary action feel pressable. Secondary, quiet, and informational surfaces remain grounded.

rules.name: Soft-Paper, Crisp-Pixel
rules.body: Paper and controls curve; voxel marks remain square. Do not blur the distinction.

dos: Do source every new application UI decision from semantic `HearthTheme` roles and the storybook primitives.
Do keep one expressive Fredoka heading, brief Nunito guidance, and one obvious next action in each focused state.
Do preserve the twilight-cover, parchment-folio, coral-binding nesting when using the canonical storybook shell.
Do keep touch targets at least 48px, content scrollable at large type, controls clear of the keyboard and safe area, and state changes understandable with reduced motion.
Do use the code-built voxel hearth or equally intentional code-native pixel details to connect interface and shared home.
Do pair error color with calm, actionable, relationship-safe language and a visible recovery path.
donts: Don't import `ui`, `editorial`, or `hearthUi` into new surfaces; they are compatibility-only exports to migrate, not normative alternatives.
Don't replace the one-story column with a generic account modal, dashboard card stack, or dense settings composition.
Don't spend coral, sage, gold, and clay as interchangeable accents; each has a distinct semantic job.
Don't smooth the voxel hearth into a generic icon, add decorative raster art without provenance, or detach UI imagery from the recognizable voxel world.
Don't use urgency, blame, competitive progress, surveillance cues, or raw infrastructure language in visual feedback.
Don't pin actions over content when the keyboard, short height, or larger text needs the folio to scroll.
